faq.q: What is a titanium serrated lock washer?
faq.a: A titanium serrated lock washer is a precision-machined fastener component used in external tooth serrated lock washer (beta-c). Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium serrated lock washer?
faq.a: Titanium Serrated Lock Washer is designed for external tooth serrated lock washer (beta-c). The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium serrated lock washer manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Serrated Lock Washer is manufactured using Cold heading. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium serrated lock washer?
faq.a: The most common issue is thread galling (cold welding) when titanium threads mate without anti-seize compound. Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
